start.speaker: Narrator
start.text: You leave the box with Kronos and see a room full of cats doing something you weren't expecting: partying--

TI1.speaker: Narrator
TI1.text: --clinking cups, cheering, spilling milk on their brown furs and metal shields, discarded at their feet. Some of them are talking, others are throwing dice and calculating throws.

TI2.speaker: Narrator
TI2.text: They look like soldiers just returned from a war, celebrating a great victory.

TI3.speaker: Narrator
TI3.text: Kronos puts a paw around your shoulders and guides you through the multitude.

TI5.speaker: Kronos
TI5.text: Don't get drunk or you'll lose. No one can hold their alcohol like Mercury.

TI7.speaker: Narrator
TI7.text: Kronos looks very proud of himself.

TI12.speaker: Narrator
TI12.text: A booming voice interrupts your conversation.

TI13.speaker: Kronos
TI13.text: Tsk. There he is. Be careful, kitty.

TI14.speaker: Narrator
TI14.text: You are about to protest when Kronos pushes you forward and you stumble at the feet of a very...

TI15.speaker: Narrator
TI15.text: ...small, fluffy, spiky cat with tiny eyes and brown fur.

TI16.speaker: Narrator
TI16.text: You glance back, but Kronos has disappeared.

TI18.text: Who's this little kitty? A follower of Kronos's?

TI20.speaker: Narrator
TI20.text: Mercury, the trickster, God of commerce and thieves, laughs in your face.

TI21.speaker: Narrator
TI21.text: You can smell the alcohol in his breath.

TI22.speaker: Mercury
TI22.text: You're here for the can of tuna ol' Kronos lost? I'm surprised you would wager your soul for him!

TI23.speaker: Narrator
TI23.text: Mercury slams his paw into the table and interrupts your thoughts about the soul-trading. Four stone dice on the table shake.

end.speaker: Mercury
end.text: Then join me for a round of Tali, and let the dice decide your fate!

start.speaker: Kronos
start.text: Ok, friend, before we head in, I'll teach you how to play Tali.

TT1.speaker: Kronos
TT1.text: It's a simple game, so you'd better catch on quickly.

TW1.speaker: Narrator
TW1.text: You lean over the table, eagerly calculating the last points of the game...

TW3.speaker: Narrator
TW3.text: The drunk Mercury slumps over the table and sniffles.

TW5.speaker: Narrator
TW5.text: He raises his head and takes a big gulp from his cup of fermented milk drink, descending even more into drunkenness.

TW8.speaker: Narrator
TW8.text: Kronos appears next to you and slings his paw over your shoulder.

TW9.speaker: Kronos
TW9.text: I knew you could do it.

TW10.speaker: Player
TW10.text: You abandoned me, Kronos, what the fu-

TW11.speaker: Kronos
TW11.text: Ay-oh-kay, we're going to take my dear tuna can and leave! Bye, Mercury!

end.speaker: Narrator
end.text: You jump back into the box, leaving a drunk Mercury to sob on the table.

TW1.speaker: Narrator
TW1.text: You lean over the table, eagerly calculating the last points of the game...

TW3.speaker: Narrator
TW3.text: The drunk Mercury raises his paws up high and cheers.

TW5.speaker: Narrator
TW5.text: He points a claw at your face.

TW7.speaker: Narrator
TW7.text: Mercury takes a swig of his fermented milk and orders another drink.

TW8.speaker: Player
TW8.text: Soul? No one said anything about a soul-

TW9.speaker: Mercury
TW9.text: You're a mortal, you lose, you give me your soul.

TW10.speaker: Narrator
TW10.text: You stumble back. Kronos appears behind you and drags you into the crowds.

TW11.speaker: Narrator
TW11.text: Fortunately for you, Mercury is too drunk to notice right away.

TW12.speaker: Kronos
TW12.text: Ok, kitty, we'll have to redo this. But promise me you'll win next time, alright?

TW13.speaker: Kronos
TW13.text: The world dissolves into a swirl of colors and fades to black.

end.speaker: Narrator
end.text: The hands of time turn back and you forget this ever happened...
